name: Smash Showdown
desc:
📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)
⭐ Please like and favorite the game for more updates.

💻 [CONTROLS]:
Attack – Left Click (X) (Usable mid-air)
Multi-Jump – Space (Up to 3 jumps, footstool on opponent’s head)
Dash – Q (L3) Cancel/Evasive (while Tumbled)
Block – F (RB) 
Emotes – B (R-Dpad)

🎮 [ATTACK VARIATIONS]:
Uppercut – Look Up + Attack (Y)
Down Slam – Look Down + Attack (B)
